subject: Import csv file problem since updating to new version

messages.author: 76529cb966c86455
messages.subject: Import csv file problem since updating to new version
parts:
Since up updated to R 2.6.2 and the newest version of Rattle, I am
having trouble working with CSV files that worked fine previously. I
can load them in under the first tab (Data), but when I go to the
Select tab to assign each variable to Input, Target, etc., no data
shows up--just a blank input box with radio buttons where the first
column should be listed.

Have I forgotten to download some package?

Thanks,
Mark

Hi Graham,

I have version 2.6.2 of R installed, and version 2.3.7 of Rattle, and
am running it on Windows XP Pro.

I tried importing one of the sample files from R in CSV format, and
that worked just fine. The curious thing is that I'm these are the
same CSV files that worked fine prior to updating to R 2.6.2 and
Rattle 2.3.7. Previously, I had R 2.6.1. I'm not sure which version
of Rattle I was using, but I believe I downloaded it sometime in
November of 2007. My records and all fields show up correctly in the
Data tab, but when I go to the Select tab, it is empty.

The error that shows up in the R console is:

"gth(target) > 0 & length(ident) > 0 & target %in% ident) target <-
NULL :
argument is of length zero"

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,
Mark

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Import csv file problem since updating to new version
parts:
Thanks for the error message Mark. Now fixed (and in the soon to be
released 2.3.8).

It was an R programming error! They should have been "&&" not "&" in
that bit of code. The whole point of the first two tests was to avoid
doing the third if either of the first two failed!!! The "&&" stops
once it gets a FALSE. Ouch. Sorry for the trouble.

The problem only shows up when there are no identifiers and no target
identified when the data is being loaded! For example, a matrix of
real numbers with no column having less than 5 unique values.

I've a couple of other updates to add into 2.3.8 before I release to
CRAN, but a temporary update to 2.3.7 is on rattle.togaware.com.

Regards,
Graham
